name: sidebar
useFor: Use for an app's main navigation (an order console, a developer dashboard). Wrap the page in SidebarProvider with the Sidebar and a SidebarInset beside it; put the wordmark or a switcher in SidebarHeader, groups of SidebarMenu rows in SidebarContent and the account in SidebarFooter. Mark the current row with isActive. Set collapsible="icon" to let it narrow to glyphs (give rows a tooltip), floating or inset for the window looks. On phones it opens in the sheet; Cmd or Ctrl and B toggles it.
constraints: A sidebar on a marketing page
title: Sidebar
description: An app's rail: a white column with a rule at its edge, quiet rows, mono group labels and the pale blue current row.
